title: Pokebelt [Cobblemon]
description: This mod adds Pokebelt from Pokemon games/anime which works as additional storage for pokeballs
body:
# Pokebelt

**Pokebelt** is an essential QoL add-on for the Cobblemon mod that introduces a functional Pokémon trainer's belt. Tired of Poké Balls cluttering your inventory? The main goal of this mod is to free up your space by providing a dedicated, stylish, and upgradeable storage specifically for your catching tools!

## ✨ Key Features

*   **Dedicated Ball Storage:** The belt acts as a specialized pouch where you can store all your Poké Balls, Great Balls, Ultra Balls, and any custom Cobblemon balls.
*   **Accessories Integration:** The belt does not take up any vanilla armor slots! It equips smoothly into a dedicated slot provided by the Accessories mod.
*   **Smart Pickup System:** Any Poké Balls you pick up from the ground will automatically be transferred directly into your belt's slots, bypassing your main inventory.
*   **Quick Access:** Keep all your tools for catching new Pokémon organized in one convenient place, always ready to use. Just scroll and throw!

## 🎮 Controls & Combinations

*   **\[B\]** - Open/Close belt's GUI
* **Shift + [B]** - Open belt's inventory
*   **Shift + Right click (Belt Opened)** - Puts pokeball from belt slot in inventory
*   **Shift + Right click (Belt Closed)** - Puts pokeball from hand in belt slot
*   **\[Q\] (Belt Opened)** - Throw out pokeballs from slot on the ground
*   **Right Click (Belt Opened) - throw the pokball**

## 📈 Progression & Upgrades

You don't just get an infinite belt right away. You have to earn your slots! You can increase your belt's capacity in two ways:

1.  **Crafting Upgrades:** Use a special recipe in the Crafting Table to manually upgrade your belt's capacity. _(Check the Gallery tab for recipe screenshots)._
2.  **Pokédex Milestones:** Catching **unique** Pokémon species grants passive capacity bonuses. _(Example: Catching 20 Rattatas will only count as 1 unique species)._ Whenever you hit a catch milestone, a **notification card** will slide onto your screen to give information about pokemon and catch numbers!

## 🎨 Customization & Dyeing

The belt is not only a convenient tool but also a way of self-expression! You can use dyes to customize its appearance.

*   **Two-Part Dyeing:** The belt is divided into the _Base_ and the _Elements_.
    *   To dye the **Elements**, combine the Belt + Dye.
    *   To dye the **Base**, combine the Belt + 1 Leather + Dye.
*   **Color Mixing:** Just like vanilla leather armor, applying multiple dyes will mix the colors together (Colors will mix after you used dye the at first time or if you put 2 dyes at the same time)!
*   **Dynamic GUI:** The belt's on-screen GUI will automatically adjust to match the custom colors of your dyed belt!

> **💡 Tip:** If you want to wash the dye off and start over, simply right-click a Cauldron filled with water while holding the belt!

## ⚙️ Fully Configurable

You can configure your belt capacity and milestones via ModMenu or mod's config:

*   Starting and Maximum slot capacity.
*   How many unique Pokémon are needed to get a Pokedex slot bonus.
*   The position of the milestone notification card (Bottom, Top, Left, Right, or Disabled).
*   GUI Theme (Dynamic, Light, or Dark).

## 📦 Required Dependencies

*   Cobblemon
*   Fabric API
*   Accessories
*   **Cloth Config API** _(Optional)_
*   **ModMenu** _(Optional)_

***

**💬 Feedback & Support:** If you have suggestions for improving the mod or happen to find a bug, please let me know in the feedback section on mod's [Discord page](https://discord.com/channels/934267676354834442/1518941185308102697)!
